title: RusCode: Russian Cultural Code Benchmark for Text-to-Image Generation
findings: The paper did not report specific findings for the religious categories. The general finding was that models with specific training on Russian culture (Kandinsky 3.1, YandexART 2) significantly outperformed globally popular models (Stable Diffusion 3, DALL-E 3) in generating images that accurately reflect Russian cultural concepts. This included religious elements like Orthodox churches and holidays, suggesting the latter models have a lower 'cultural awareness' of Russian religious visual culture.
